summary: SpeakLink: full backend (21 pytest cases) + frontend E2E (Playwright) done. All 21 backend tests pass; all critical frontend flows pass (login, console widgets, store selection, confirm modal, emergency stop, store management, history, logs, receiver invalid/valid token). One functional spec gap identified: emergency-stop does NOT broadcast STOP to all connected receivers (only to targeted ones). Also flagged minor code-quality issues.

minor.issue: Spec says emergency-stop should broadcast STOP to ALL connected receivers as a safety net, but _end_session() only iterates manager.live_target_store_ids. Non-targeted receivers never receive the STOP JSON message. Test observed: ws2 (not targeted) got no stop. Recommend: in emergency path, iterate set(live_target_store_ids) | set(receivers.keys()).
@api.get('/') is defined AFTER app.include_router(api), so it never registers. GET /api/ returns 404. Move the route above include_router (cosmetic).

Store status persistence: on abrupt WS drop, store.status stays 'online' in DB. No server-side stale-connection heartbeat/timeout cleanup — a killed pod can leave receivers 'online' until the WS TCP finally errors out.

When a broadcast session ends via /stop or /emergency-stop, the active broadcaster WS is not force-closed server-side; relies on frontend to call bc.stop(). If the operator loses network mid-broadcast, session ends but broadcaster slot remains taken until TCP dies.

list_stores mutates loaded SQLAlchemy objects (s.status = ...) without persisting. Because autoflush=False & session is closed without commit, it works, but this is fragile — a future refactor enabling autoflush would silently overwrite DB status. Consider computing status in a plain dict for response instead of mutating ORM objects.

integration_issues.issue: WS to /api/ws/hq occasionally logs 'closed before the connection is established' on rapid nav — not blocking; reconnect logic on receiver side exists but HQ dashboard has none (fine for MVP).

issues: Store table row is highlighted only in blue-50/40 for targeted rows — contrast with white/even:slate-50 is subtle; consider a left border accent for stronger visual affordance.
Stat cards font-mono with tight numbers looks good, but 'Selected/Online/Offline' labels are 10px tracking-widest which is hard to read at 14"+ desktop distance.

action_items: Fix _end_session (server.py) to also send STOP to all currently-connected receivers when triggered via emergency-stop, per spec. This is the only functional deviation from the requirement spec.
Move @api.get('/') declaration ABOVE app.include_router(api) so GET /api/ returns 200 (currently 404).
Remove stray /app/backend/=2.0.0 file (pip install artifact — file literally named '=2.0.0').
Consider adding server-side WS heartbeat timeout to reset stale 'online' store.status entries.
Optional: force-close active broadcaster WS when a session is stopped/emergency-stopped, so a stuck client can't hold the broadcaster slot.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 542-543: `@api.get('/')` is dead code (registered after include_router).
server.py 113-118: mutating ORM objects (`s.status = ...`) during read endpoint. Safe today due to autoflush=False but bug-prone.
server.py 265-278 (_end_session): emergency stop does NOT fan out STOP to non-targeted receivers. Spec violation.
ws_manager.py: `receivers` map has no TTL/heartbeat sweep — abandoned connections linger and mislead online counts.
Broadcaster WS handler: no auto-timeout while idle; combined with above, a broken TCP could hold the broadcaster slot forever.
backend/.env still contains MONGO_URL/DB_NAME even though module uses SQLite (harmless leftover from template).
Stray file /app/backend/=2.0.0 (accidental pip install output redirected to file).
test_credentials: [REMOVED INSECURE HISTORICAL DEFAULT] (was documented in memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create 'TEST_*' stores (soft-deleted at end of duplicate test) and 'TEST_*' broadcast sessions. Visible on /stores page as disabled entries — safe to leave (or main agent can delete rows where store_code LIKE 'TEST-%').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest -n 0` (serial). The pytest.ini uses -n 2 loadscope but Broadcast + Websocket tests need serial execution to avoid state races; hence `-n 0` override recommended. Frontend: use data-testids listed in problem statement — they are all present and functional. Note that the receiver page's WS may show DISCONNECTED momentarily when the receiver-store's WS already has an active connection (server kicks the older with 4001). Also BLR-001 might appear 'online' in DB if a prior lingering WS existed — that is a real backend caching gap and not test noise.
rca of the issue: Emergency-stop safety-net gap: `_end_session` iterates `manager.live_target_store_ids` only. Fix: in emergency path (or in `_end_session` when reason='emergency'), broadcast STOP to `set(manager.live_target_store_ids) | set(manager.receivers.keys())`. This preserves current-target behavior for normal /stop and adds the required all-receivers safety broadcast for emergency-stop.
